payload.core_mechanism_summary: Nested loops over all integer shifts x,y from -50 to 50, computing overlap sum for each shift by iterating over first table cells and checking validity. Keeps track of maximum.
payload.rationale: The solution simply enumerates all possible shifts, a brute-force complete search. Among given subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the closest generic complete search, though it lacks recursion or pruning typical of backtracking. No other subtype fits better.
